Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [1b] Extend: MappingPage overview
          `-- Add document.diagramContexts as canvas-owned associations, separate from each Diagram's sourceContext; attach the association detail from this component.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
          `-- Show the controller installing an issued revision rather than asking DiagramService to prepare the content edit; retain its operation and checkpoint flow.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
          `-- Show history retaining issued immutable revisions and checkpoint bindings, not issuing content revisions during append.
      `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Reorganize the obsolete single-service writer into revision issuance, explicit retention, asynchronous generation and separate canvas publication.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Reorganize resolution around scoped uploads, saved IDs and diagram-bound fallback, then show scoped generation and installation; preserve request retries and acknowledgements.
      |-- [4] Redraw: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
          `-- Organize the expanded edit, create and extend inputs by target, replacement scope, pinned references, context source and request identity.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
          `-- Add created-diagram or retained-variant outputs and the next panel context without changing the run-status lifecycle.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
          `-- Distinguish uploaded trajectories from saved immutable contexts; account for version-2 snapshots with pinned source-range references.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
          `-- Distinguish the hashed context descriptor from source-file attachments and show resolution before Pi-message conversion.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
          `-- Replace the in-memory SessionManager claim with persisted Pi sessions; copied historical calls remain context, not executions.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
          `-- Add lazy source expansion and panel-session continuation to generation.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
          `-- Show issuance and retention before controller installation; the canvas checkpoint binds the exact revision.
      `-- [2] Add: Diagram AgentContext association and fallback
          `-- Develop the overview's DiagramEditService fallback: store compiled evidence behind a compact document association, require a matching source fingerprint, and supply the current diagram separately.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Replace the edit-only generation description with edit, create and extend operations; remove the fixed tool-count claim while retaining the transport grouping.
      |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Add AgentChat's create, list and read saved-context tools alongside canvas-scoped upload.
      `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Show AgentChatService calling AgentContextLibrary and generation resolving saved IDs through AgentContextService; attach library detail from these components.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
          `-- Add the saved-context repository, pinned source records and diagram-context backing store; distinguish their immutable records from canvas checkpoint references.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Include document context associations in persisted canvas state while leaving backing source records separate and lazily resolved.
  `-- [3] Saved AgentContexts and pinned source evidence  new canvas
      |-- Saved-context library and lookup
          `-- Show AgentContextLibrary's explicit creation, listing and global lookup, with AgentContextService routing saved IDs separately from scoped uploads; connect from the AgentContext edit-flow context-resolution component.
      |-- Immutable saved-context publication
          `-- Develop AgentContextRepository's UUID request identity, argument-conflict checks and exclusive atomic publication across retries and restarts.
      `-- Source capture and lazy resolution
          `-- Develop AgentContextSources' registered relative paths, Git-commit or content-hash pins, compact ranges and separate resolution or portable export; connect also from PersistentLayer's pinned-source-record component.
